info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Internal Audit Reviews Management API
info.description: The Internal Audit Reviews Management API facilitates the submission and organization of reviews related to internal audits. This endpoint enables users to create new review entries, ensuring consistent documentation and tracking of audit feedback. Typical consumers include internal auditors and compliance teams who require effective management of audit review processes. By integrating this API, organizations can enhance their internal review procedures and maintain a clear audit trail.

post.summary: Create a review for the internal audit of a specific enterprise service.
post.description: This operation allows users to create a new review for the internal audit process associated with the enterprise service identified by RES-100045. Users can submit detailed feedback that will be used for evaluation and improvement of the internal audit.
